ANSALAPI.NS.d: Ansal Properties & Infrastructure Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development business in India. The company develops integrated townships, condominiums, group housings, malls, shopping complexes, hotels, clubs, SEZs, IT parks, and infrastructure and utility services, as well as other mixed-use and standalone developments in the residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality segments. It also provides facilities management services.

ARABIAN.NS.d: Arabian Petroleum Ltd. is an Indian company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of a diverse range of lubricants and specialty oils, operating within the downstream petroleum sector. Its primary products include automotive lubricants such as engine oils, gear oils, transmission fluids, and coolants, sold under the Arzol brand.

ASHOKA.NS.d: Ashoka Buildcon Limited operates as an infrastructure development company in India. The company operates through three segments: Construction & Contract Related Activity; Built, Operate and Transfer (BOT); and Sale of Goods. It engages in the construction of infrastructure facilities on engineering, procurement, and construction basis, as well as built, operate, and transfer basis.

BAJAJFINSV.NS.d: Bajaj Finserv Ltd. (‘Bajaj Finserv', ‘BFS' or ‘the Company') is the holding company for the various financial services businesses under the Bajaj group. It serves millions of customers by providing solutions for asset acquisition through financing, asset protection through general insurance, family and income protection in the form of life and health insurance and retirement and savings solutions.

BALAJITELE.NS.d: Balaji Telefilms Limited engages in the entertainment business in India and internationally. It operates through Commissioned Programmes, Films, and Digital segments. The company produces and distributes television content and films primarily in Hindi under the Balaji Telefilms brand name; and produces reality shows, events, and Bengali contents. It is also involved in the B2C digital content business under the brand name of ALT Balaji; and creates intellectual property rights.

BALUFORGE.NS.d: Balu Forge Industries Limited, based in Mumbai, makes crankshafts and supplies them worldwide directly to original equipment manufacturers. It also offers railway wheels, undercarriages, chassis, hydraulic motors, turbine blades and transmission and clutch systems, plus brake parts, forged components and items for oil, gas and flow control. Customers span many industries, including agricultural machinery.

BANKA.NS.d: Banka BioLoo Limited provides products and services for human waste management system in India. It manufactures, supplies, and installs bio-tanks for digestion of human waste. The company is also involved in the operation and maintenance of bio-toilets and CDTS; sale of spares of control discharge toilet system to Indian railways; and treatment and management of fecal sludge, as well as waste water treatment and recycling solutions. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

BBL.NS.d: Bharat Bijlee Limited operates as an electrical engineering company in India. It operates through two segments, Power Systems and Industrial Systems. The company offers transformers, such as sub-station, generator, unit auxiliary, and single phase traction transformers; three phase squirrel cage induction motors; gearless belt machines for passenger lifts and elevators; gearless machines for home elevators, heavy duty goods, and heavy goods lifts; and AC drives, servo drives, and motion controllers.

BURNPUR.NS.d: Burnpur Cement Limited manufactures and sells cement in India. It offers Portland slag cement. Burnpur Cement Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Kolkata, India.

BUTTERFLY.NS.d: Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances Limited manufactures and sells domestic kitchen and electrical appliances under the Butterfly brand name in India. The company's kitchen appliances comprise mixer grinders, LPG stoves, pressure cookers, electric rice cookers, table top wet grinders, juicers, hand blenders, chimneys, power hobs, pop-up toasters, sandwich makers, and water kettles.

CEIGALL.NS.d: Ceigall India Limited is an infrastructure construction company based in Gurugram, India. It offers engineering, procurement and construction of elevated roads, overpasses, bridges, railway crossings, metropolitan transit systems, tunnels and road networks such as highways and expressways.

CHOLAFIN.NS.d: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides various financial services in India. The company operates through three segments: Vehicle Finance Loans, Home Equity, and Other Loans.

DEVIT-SM.NS.d: DEV INFORMATION TE is an IT service provider offering services like, digital transformation, and outsourcing services.

ERIS.NS.d: Eris Lifesciences Limited manufactures, markets, and distributes pharmaceutical products in India. It offers various branded formulations in various therapeutic areas, such as cardiovascular, anti–diabetes, anti- infective, antipyretics, vitamins/nutrients, gastroenterology, acute and chronic respiratory, gynecology, pediatrics, neurology, psychiatry, arthritis, and pain/analgesics, as well as in-vitro fertilization, cancer, multi-therapy, cosmetology, and dermatology.

EXCELSOFT.NS.d: Excelsoft Technologies Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker EXCELSOFT and traded in INR. Its country is India.

EXPLEOSOL.NS.d: Expleo Solutions Limited, together with its subsidiaries, primarily provides software validation and verification services worldwide. The company offers consultancy services, such as business agility, digital business, and transformation delivery; engineering services, including design, production, and in-service support; quality engineering, testing, and management services; and training services.

GVKPIL.NS.d: GVK Power & Infrastructure Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides operation and maintenance, manpower and consultancy, and incidental services to the owners of power plants, airports, and infrastructure companies in India and internationally. It operates through Roads, Power, Airport, and Others segments.

HCC.NS.d: Hindustan Construction Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, primarily provides engineering and construction services in India. It constructs roads, highways, expressways, bridges, elevated corridors, railways, metro rails, ports, and marine structures; dams, barrages, tunnels, powerhouses, shafts, and various underground works; and reactors, auxiliary buildings, spent fuel buildings, safety pump houses, and control buildings.

HLVLTD.NS.d: HLV Limited owns, operates, and manages hotel in Mumbai, India. It operates The Leela hotel with 391 guest rooms. The company was formerly known as Hotel Leelaventure Limited and changed its name to HLV Limited in December 2019. HLV Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.

HRYNSHP.NS.d: Hariyana Ship Breakers Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker HRYNSHP and traded in INR. Its country is India.

IKIO.NS.d: IKIO Technologies Limited, founded in 2016 and based in Noida, designs and produces LED lighting and energy products for the Indian market as an original design manufacturer. It was called IKIO Lighting Limited until March 2025, and its products include LED lights, switches, hardware and LED refrigeration lights.

INDORAMA.NS.d: Indo Rama Synthetics (India) Limited manufactures and supplies polyester in India, Indonesia, Thailand, the United States, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Turkey. The company offers various polyester products, including polyester staple fiber, polyester filament yarn, draw texturized yarn, fully drawn yarn, and textile grade chips. Its products are used in various applications, such as apparel and sportswear, home furnishings and textiles, non-woven, and automotive.

KDGREEN.NS.d: KD Green Industries Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker KDGREEN and traded in INR. Its country is India.

LCL.NS.d: Lohia Corp Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker LCL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

MAITHANALL-BL.NS.d: Maithan Alloys Limited manufactures and exports manganese alloys. The company's products are used in the steel industry. The company is based in India.

MFSL.NS.d: X Financial provides personal finance services in the People's Republic of China. The company offers services as an online marketplace connecting borrowers and investors. Its loan product is Xiaoying credit loan, which consists of Xiaoying card loan catering to the credit card holders and Xiaoying preferred loan to small business owners.

MPHASIS.NS.d: Mphasis Limited operates as an information technology solutions provider that specializes in cloud and cognitive services worldwide. The company operates through Banking and Capital Market, Insurance, Information Technology, Communication and Entertainment, and Emerging Industries segments. It offers application, blockchain, business process, cloud, cognitive, cyber security, DevOps, digital, product engineering, infrastructure, and enterprise automation, as well as governance, risk, and compliance services.

NEWGEN.NS.d: Newgen Software Technologies Limited provides software products and solutions in India, Australia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and the United States.

NITTAGELA.NS.d: Nitta Gelatin India Limited manufactures and markets gelatin and collagen products. The company serves various industries, including food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic. Nitta Gelatin India is headquartered in Kochi, India.

ONWARDTEC.NS.d: Onward Technologies Limited provides mechanical engineering design and IT consulting services in India and internationally. The company offers product engineering, manufacturing engineering, mechanical engineering, simulation engineering, and engineering change management services; electronics and embedded systems; electrical and electronics solutions; and technical publications.

ORBTEXP.NS.d: Orbit Exports Limited manufactures and sells fabrics, ribbons, and made ups in India. It operates in two segments, Manufacturing of Textile and Renewable Source of Energy. The company offers faux silk fabrics, fashion Jaquards, and Christmas crafts. It also operates in the United States, Latin America, Africa, Europe, and the Far East. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

PARIN.NS.d: Parin Enterprises Ltd. is an India-based furniture maker and distributor. Its products include hospital beds and trolleys, school desks and laboratory furniture, modular office workstations and ergonomic chairs, household sofas and dining tables, and public seating. It serves healthcare, education, corporate and residential customers through a network of retail stores and dealers.

PATELRMART.NS.d: Patel Retail Ltd. is an Indian company known for its chain of supermarkets and also manufactures and distributes products in several categories. It sells whole and ground spices and flours under the Indian Chaska brand, and household and home improvement items, among them cleaning tools, disinfectants and detergents, under other labels.

POWERICA.NS.d: Powerica Ltd. makes, markets, installs, commissions and services diesel and gas power plants through Generator Sets and Wind Power segments. The first covers generating sets, components and related services, while the second generates electricity from wind turbine generators and provides installation, operation and project management. Naresh Oberoi founded it on May 4, 1984.

PROSTARM.NS.d: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd. designs, makes, sells and services energy storage and power conditioning equipment for India and overseas. Its main products are uninterruptible power supply systems, including line interactive, online and modular configurations, supported by rental and after-sales services, along with other power products.

RATNAMANI.NS.d: Ratnamani Metals & Tubes Limited manufactures and sells stainless steel pipes and tubes, and carbon steel pipes in India and internationally. The company's stainless steel products comprise seamless and welded tubes, and heat exchanger tubes; and instrumentation tubes. It also provides nickel alloy seamless heat exchanger tubes; titanium welded tubes; induction bending; and carbon steel products, such as high frequency electric resistance and submerged arc welded pipes.

RAYMOND.NS.d: Raymond Limited operates as a textile, lifestyle, and branded apparel company in India and internationally. It operates through Textile, Shirting, Apparel, Garmenting, Tools and Hardware, Auto Components, Real Estate Development, and Others segments. The company offers wool, poly-wool, silk, polyester viscose blended, cotton blended, linen blended, and other blended suiting fabrics; and cotton and linen shirting fabrics under the Raymond Fine Fabrics brand name.

ROLLT.NS.d: Rollatainers Limited, an integrated packaging company, researches, manufactures, and markets lined and mono cartons and packaging machines in India. It operates a café chain under the Barista brand; and restaurants, which offers Japanese, Thai, Burmese, and Chinese cuisines under the Kylin brand name. The company operates 16 restaurants. It also exports its products. Rollatainers Limited was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Rewari, India.

RPTECH.NS.d: Rashi Peripherals Limited distributes information and communication technology products from many brands across India. Its offerings cover accessories, power products, memory and storage, lifestyle items, components, embedded technologies, enterprise solutions, mobile devices and personal computing.

SANDUMA.NS.d: The Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores Limited and its subsidiary mainly mine manganese and iron ore at Deogiri village in Karnataka. Its three segments are mining, ferroalloys, and coke and energy; it makes ferroalloys and coke and runs a 32-megawatt thermal power plant. Incorporated in 1954 and based in Bengaluru, it is controlled by Skand Private Limited.

SHANTI.NS.d: Shanti Overseas (India) Limited processes and sells agricultural goods, with a focus on soya products. These include organic soybean meal, seeds, lecithin, and soybean oils in crude and refined form, as well as sunflower lecithin, soy fatty acids and soya soap stocks.

SHEETAL.NS.d: Sheetal Universal Ltd. operates within the agriculture industry, specializing in the processing, packaging, and supply of various agricultural commodities. The company's primary products include edible oils, peanuts, sesame seeds, pulses, spices such as fenugreek, cumin, turmeric, dill seeds, kalunji, and fennel seeds, as well as grains like sorghum, rice, and chickpeas. They also offer other products such as raisins, desiccated coconut, and dehydrated onion and garlic.

SHIL.NS.d: Somany Home Innovation Limited engages in the sale and distribution of consumer and building products under the Hindware brand. It offers kitchen ensembles, such as chimneys, cooktops, built-in hobs, cooking ranges, induction cookers, food waste disposers, built-in microwave ovens, built-in ovens, dishwashers, and kitchen sinks; storage, instant, and gas water heaters; desert, personal, tower, window, and mini coolers; RO+UV and UV water purifiers, and air purifiers under the moonbow brand; ceiling fans; hinges,…

SMPL.NS.d: Splendid Metal Products Limited manufactures and trades in steel products in India. The company was formerly known as Sujana Metal Products Limited and changed its name to Splendid Metal Products Limited in November 2016. Splendid Metal Products Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

SUNSHINE.NS.d: Sun And Shine Worldwide Limited is involved in trading and investment activities. The company deals in various products and commodities. Sun And Shine Worldwide Limited is based in India.

TAC.NS.d: TAC Infosec Ltd., operating as TAC Security, is a global cybersecurity company specializing in risk-based vulnerability management and assessment solutions, cybersecurity quantification, and penetration testing services. The company delivers its offerings through a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) model. Its flagship product is the Enterprise Security in One Framework (ESOF) platform, which leverages artificial intelligence and machine learning for automated vulnerability detection, cyber risk scoring, and analytics.

TAINWALCHM.NS.d: Tainwala Chemicals and Plastics (India) Limited manufactures and sells extruded plastic sheets in India. The company operates in two segments, Plastic Sheets and Securities Trading. It offers PVC rigid, flexible, and corrugated sheets, as well as PVC foils; and polypropylene, talc filled polypropylene, glass-fabric laminated polypropylene, high density polyethylene, high impact polystyrene, acrylonitrile, and polypropylene copolymer sheets. The company is also involved in the securities trading business.

TALWALKARS.NS.d: Talwalkars Better Value Fitness Limited operates a chain of health centers under the Talwalkars brand name in India. The company offers gym, spa, aerobics, and health counseling services. The company was founded in 1932 and is based in Mumbai, India.

TATACAP.NS.d: Tata Capital Limited provides financial services through its subsidiaries to retail, small business, corporate and institutional clients in India, Singapore and the United Kingdom. Its segments are Financing Activity, Investment Activity and Others. Lending products include asset financing, term loans, invoice discounting, power project finance, home loans, personal loans and vehicle loans.

TNPETRO.NS.d: Tamilnadu Petroproducts Limited manufactures and sells petrochemical and industrial intermediate chemical products in India. The company offers linear alkyl benzene, an organic compound used in the manufacture of domestic detergents, institutional, and industrial cleaners under the SUPERLAB brand; caustic soda, a chemical for use in textile, pulp and paper, aluminum, and soap and detergent industries; and chlorine, a co-product of caustic soda for use in various sectors, including vinyl chloride, chlorinated…

TRANSWORLD.NS.d: Transworld Shipping Lines Ltd. provides containerised shipping on India's coast and international routes, owning and managing container feeder vessels. The fleet includes container ships and dry bulk vessels, serving industries such as steel, infrastructure, defence, thermal power and oil and energy. It was formerly Shreyas Shipping and Logistics Limited.

UNITDSPR.NS.d: United Spirits Limited makes, procures and distributes alcoholic beverages in India and globally. Its categories include gin, vodka, rum, brandy, Indian-made foreign liquor whisky and Scotch whisky, and its brands include McDowell's No.1, Royal Challenge, Signature, Antiquity and Black Dog.

UNITY.NS.d: Unity Infraprojects Limited engages in the construction and engineering activities in India. The company undertakes projects in buildings and housing, transportation, water supply, and irrigation. It constructs dams, tunnels, bridges, flyovers, subways, roads, and buildings. It serves various companies and governments. Unity Infraprojects Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Mumbai, India.

UNIVCABLES.NS.d: Universal Cables Limited manufactures and sells electrical and other cables, capacitors, wires and conductors, and other products under the UNISTAR brand name in India.

VIAZ.NS.d: Viaz Tyres Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer specializing in a range of rubber products, primarily tyres and tubes, for various vehicle segments. The company's core product portfolio includes bicycle tyres, bicycle butyl moulded tubes, and rubber tubes for two and three-wheelers, passenger vehicles, light commercial vehicles, off-the-road vehicles, industrial, and farm equipment. Additionally, Viaz Tyres offers ancillary products such as lubricants, grease, tubeless tyre kits, and multipurpose air pumps.

VMSTMT.NS.d: VMS TMT Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker VMSTMT and traded in INR. Its country is India.
